recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, textured oil painting featuring a dark, silhouetted figure against a swirling, fiery background of oranges and reds. The composition is punctuated by a sharp yellow lightning bolt and a jagged yellow sunburst graphic containing secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark silhouette vs. fiery warm background
Geometric lightning bolt vs. organic brushstrokes
Right-aligned heavy display type vs. centered lowercase sans-serif
Jagged sunburst sticker as a focal point for metadata
coreInvariants: Heavy impasto texture in the background
Warm color palette (red, orange, yellow, black)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, dark, textured silhouette occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, reaching from bottom to top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette provides the primary weight, while the yellow lightning bolt acts as a vertical divider.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the heavy top-right text, follow the lightning bolt down into the silhouette, and then move to the bright yellow sunburst on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame acts as active negative space, filled with swirling orange and red textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and burnt orange (background texture)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow (lightning bolt and sunburst sticker)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with extreme value contrast between the black silhouette and the bright yellow accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and humanist sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary display text uses thick, rounded terminals and heavy strokes
Secondary text uses a cleaner, lowercase-focused sans-serif
Sticker text uses a condensed sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing (tracking) for the heavy display font
Lowercase 'g' with a rounded loop in the secondary text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy black display type for impact paired with clean white lowercase for legibility against dark backgrounds.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and rounded feel of the display text
Suitable for the clean, lowercase subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an oil painting with heavy impasto texture. The background should be a swirl of fiery oranges, reds, and yellows. On the left, place a large, dark, textured silhouette of a figure. Include a sharp, thin yellow lightning bolt cutting vertically through the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy, black, right-aligned sans-serif text in the top right corner. Add a single line of bold, white, lowercase sans-serif text across the middle of the silhouette. Place a jagged yellow sunburst sticker on the right side with red and black condensed text inside.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture visibly thick (impasto)?
Is the lightning bolt sharp and yellow?
Is the top-right text heavy and black?
Is the sunburst sticker jagged and bright yellow?

mustRedesign: Any specific band names or logos
Specific song titles in the sunburst
The record label logo in the corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the textured background
Check that the silhouette doesn't lose its form in the texture
Verify the yellow accents pop against the reds
Confirm the impasto effect looks like physical paint
recipe.reuseFormula: Impasto oil painting background + high-contrast silhouette + heavy geometric sans-serif + jagged graphic accents.
